title: CUDA error
body:

comments.author: participant4
comments.body: CUDA graphs should not be used outside of llama.cpp, the code is very finicky and it will not work correctly in different situations. To disable it, `GGML_CUDA_USE_GRAPHS` should not be defined in the build scripts.

comments.author: participant3
comments.body: fwiw, setting env `GGML_CUDA_DISABLE_GRAPHS` to `1` makes the error go away. So I am thinking it's somethign to do with 24f0aa46 that went in last month.
